string.text: Do you have any work for me?
Let's see what needs doing.
Not right now.
Let's see it.
I found what you asked for.
Good. Here is your pay.

One of our detectors was lost in the marked area. Recover it and bring it to me.

I'm here for the job.
What job do you want to talk about?
And what do you want to talk about?
What is the job you would like to talk about?
So what is it that you want to discuss?
Find the Jellyfish artifact
Find the Jellyfish artifact formed in the Springboard anomaly. Hand it in to Sidorovich. Reward: 1500 RU and a bottle of vodka.
Find the Jellyfish artifact
Some guy from the Big Land asked for a Jellyfish. It's not a lot of money, but it's a milk run. Take it!
I'm up for it.
Find the Jellyfish artifact
Job's done... and here's the reward!
Find the Stone Flower artifact
Find the Stone Flower artifact formed in the Springboard anomaly. The pay is supposed to be pretty good. Hand it in to Sidorovich. Reward: 3000 RU and a bottle of vodka.
Find the Stone Flower artifact

I have a request for the Stone Flower. The order is from the jewellers, by the way, so let's try to make the pretty ladies happy, eh? If you get it, you'll get the money and a bottle to drink to their health...
I'm up for it.
Find the Stone Flower artifact
Job's done... and here's the reward!
Find the artifact called Chunk of Meat
Find the wound-healing artifact called Chunk of Meat. Hand it in to Sidorovich. Reward: 2500 RU and 3 army medkits.
Find the artifact called Chunk of Meat
There's an order for an artifact, the kind that heals wounds, called Chunk of Meat! They have a clinic of some sort. If you get it you'll get paid and help people at the same time.
I'm up for it.
Find the artifact called Chunk of Meat
Job's done... and here's the reward!
Bring the jaw of the bloodsucker
So the tooth of the bloodsucker brings good luck? Let's see if it'll bring luck to the bloodsucker. Hand it in to Sidorovich. Reward: 3000 RU and 5 boxes of 12x76 Dart shells.
Bring the jaw of the bloodsucker

I heard a superstition that the tooth of a bloodsucker brings good luck. As if the one who wears that tooth around his neck gets past the anomalies, and artifacts fall right into his hands. Anyway, it's all bullshit, but there are some dopes who believe it all and are ready to pay well for it. If you bring the jaw of a bloodsucker, I'll pay you well.
I'm up for it.
Bring the jaw of the bloodsucker
Job's done... and here's the reward!
Bring over the tail of the pseudodog
Bring over the tail of the pseudodog. Hand it in to Sidorovich. Reward: 1500 RU and 5 boxes of 12x76 Dart shells.
Bring over the tail of the pseudodog

Winter's coming soon. And what do chicks like to wear there on the Big Land during winter? That's right - furs. So now there's a new fashion going around, making various accessories from the tails of pseudodogs. It's some sort of special fur! Bottom line, there's an order for such a tail. Will you take it?
I'm up for it.
Bring over the tail of the pseudodog
Job's done... and here's the reward!
Find the Meat chunk artifact
Find the Meat chunk artifact that heals ailments and injuries. Hand it in to the Barman. Reward: 2500 RU and 2 science medkits.
Find the Meat chunk artifact

Some padres have stopped by, left an order for a Meat chunk. You know, they have a certain interest in this healing artifact... those rotten miracle-workers! Anyway... You gonna do it? It's up to you.
I'm up for it.
Find the Meat chunk artifact
Great job, award well deserved!
Find the Crystal Thorn artifact
Find the Crystal Thorn artifact that protects against psi-attacks. Hand it in to the Barman. Reward: 2500 RU, 2 science medkits and 2 Antirads.
Find the Crystal Thorn artifact

A "crone"?.. No, that's not it. "Crystal corn"?.. No, wrong again... Bugger! "Crystal Thorn", that's it! So here's the deal: I have an order for this artifact, "Crystal Thorn". Have you heard of it? They say that if you've got one, no creature will be able to mess with your brain. So what do you say?
I'm up for it.
Find the Crystal Thorn artifact
Great job, award well deserved!
Find the Night Star artifact
Find the Night Star artifact to help the national military research effort. Hand it in to the Barman. Reward: a Berill-5M armored suit and 3 F-1 grenades.
Find the Night Star artifact

I need the Night Star artifact. I'm sorry to say it doesn't grant any wishes, been there, done that, but it can make you wealthy. Scientists pay a lot for it. They say they make some military things out of it...So, are you up for it?
I'm up for it.
Find the Night Star artifact
Great job, award well deserved!
Find the artifact Flash
Find the artifact Flash. Hand it in to the Barman. Reward: 5000 RU.
Find the artifact Flash
The assignment is simple and the pay is good. You have to find the artifact Flash. Don't even ask who ordered it and why. Well, will you do it?
I'm up for it.
Find the artifact Flash
Great job, award well deserved!
Find artifact Goldfish
Find artifact Goldfish. Hand it in to the Barman. Reward: an LR-300, an M203 grenade launcher, a SUSAT scope and a silencer.
Find artifact Goldfish

Marked One, you know the story about the fairytale about the Goldfish? Yeah, yeah, that's the one. There are a bunch of jokes about it too. So anyway, there's this old man who keeps on wanting to catch it. Bottom line, I need the one-of-a-kind artifact called Goldfish, the client is from the outside, respectable. Will you help out?
I'm up for it.
Find artifact Goldfish
Great job, award well deserved!
Obtain the flesh's eye
Obtain the flesh's eye. Hand it in to the Barman. Reward: 500 RU and 3 cans of food.
Obtain the flesh's eye

Soon we're having a party, there'll be a fancy dinner, and certain local gourmets who are in especially high spirits (we don't need to point fingers) will definitely want to try my special recipie - eyes of "flesh" under a pork sauce. That is, in its own juices under mayonnaise. Basically, I need the eye of that beast, and quickly.
I'm up for it.
Obtain the flesh's eye
Great job, award well deserved!
Bring the hoof of a boar
Bring the hoof of a boar. Hand it in to the Barman. Reward: 1500 RU.
Bring the hoof of a boar

Do you know that we prepare horns and hooves? This is a big rarity. They make great jewelry from the local mutated hooves - I know a jeweler, he's interested. So go on ahead, find the boar's hoof, and there'll be cash in your pocket.
I'm up for it.
Bring the hoof of a boar
Great job, award well deserved!
Bring the Fireball artifact
Bring the Fireball artifact to the scientists for researches. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: a "Pellicle" artifact.
Bring the Fireball artifact

We've managed to obtain the artifact in laboratory conditions! This is a breakthrough! Now all the world will hear about our success. And the Nobel Prize will be close at hand! This is the unique artifact - "Pellicle", it's main quality is to protect from the chemical burns. Do you want me to give it to you on behalf of science? However, I do have one request - in return I need the artifact "Fireball", do you know about such? Unique thermal qualities of its surface require thorough research.
I'm up for it.
Bring the Fireball artifact
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Find the "Gravi" artifact
Bring the "Gravi" artifact to the hands of the scientists. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 5000 RU and a science medkit.
Find the "Gravi" artifact

We've approached closely to the comprehension of the nature of gravitation, practically, soon enough we'll be able to create a new generation of engines on the antigravity basis, and quite probably the path to the stars will open to us. For that, we need "Gravi" artifact, and fast.
I'm up for it.
Find the "Gravi" artifact
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Find the "Jellyfish" artifact
The scientists need the "Jellyfish" artifact to carry out researches in the field of space-time. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 2500 RU and a science medkit.
Find the "Jellyfish" artifact

Our research team is on the brink of discovering the mystery of space-time. The possibility of teleportation is no longer fantasy! The Vortex is an anomaly which squeezes space rather than just gravitationally affecting objects, as believe some of my ossified opponents-theorists, who sit in the warm research facility earnestly chewing chalk. Their glasses will fog up when they find out what results science can achieve when you work in the field! Please get me the artifact "Jellyfish".
I'm up for it.
Find the "Jellyfish" artifact
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Find the "Moonlight" artifact
Provide "Moonlight" to the scientists at Yantar. A good artifact... Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 10000 RU and 3 science medkits.
Find the "Moonlight" artifact

We desperately need materials for continuing our research in the field of energetics. You see, we learned to generate energy with the help of artifacts. Granted, this works while the KPD isn't high enough. We were able to get the best results with the artifact Moonlight. Please bring us a sample for experiments.
I'm up for it.
Find the "Moonlight" artifact
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Find the artifact called Sea Urchin
The scientists need the Sea Urchin artifact to improve their suits. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: a SEVA bodysuit.
Find the artifact called Sea Urchin

You are probably aware of the fact that our suits provide the best defence against radiation. The secret lies in the fact that we saturate them with a lotion made out of quite a rare artifact. To manufacture another series of these suits we need such an artifact. You call it "Sea Urchin".
I'm up for it.
Find the artifact called Sea Urchin
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Bring a part of the snork's body
It's a piece of cake getting a fragment of a snork in these parts. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 2500 RU and a science medkit.
Bring a part of the snork's body

We got acquainted with Semenov back in the university where I was giving lectures on genetics, and he was my student. Thus I became his scientific chief. Back then, we were only slightly unveiling the curtain of mystery of genome modification. So what was I saying? Oh, right. For genetic experiments we will need the samples of fresh cells of the muscular tissue of snork. You will have to search the bogs for this genic material. There is a hypothesis that snorks as species are the new level of human's evolution. In order to know this for sure, DNA test must be procured!
I'm up for it.
Bring a part of the snork's body
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Bring the eye of a flesh

I'd better keep my body away from these eggheads just in case! Very well, I'll get them a flesh's eye, and they can do all they want with their volunteers. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 1000 RU and a SUSAT scope.
Bring the eye of a flesh

Good news, young man: we have a very interesting assignment for you! I think as an intellectual being with quite a bit of experience you will be able to appreciate my colleagues' theories. The thing is, our research revealed: the eyes of the creatures called flesh in the common language, are equipped with... are you following me?... with olfactory receptors! Thus, they can not only see with their eyes, but smell with them as well! We're getting ready for an operation on transplanting this miraculous eye to one of ... one of our voluntary assistants. I believe we're about to start a craze! By the way, would you like to become a recepient of this rather amazing organ?
I'm up for it.
Bring the eye of a flesh
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Bring the tail of a blind dog
Well, look at Science! Trying to find a second brain in humans?.. Poor dogs, one of them will have to do without a tail now. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 2000 RU and 3 boxes of 12x76 Dart shells.
Bring the tail of a blind dog

Welcome, eh... traveler! I'm so glad you dropped by: we are in need of a man to take part in a highly important experiment. My colleague Brenter wants to try and cook a meal using local fauna for a practical experiment to study the influence of mutated protein on human body. For a start, we decided to try the boars. We need ham. A boar's leg, do you undestand? And if you agree to do it, please select the healthiest specimen.
I'm up for it.
Bring the tail of a blind dog
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Bring the leg of a boar
Gourmet thrillseekers... Alright, I'll get them some ham. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 3000 RU and a science medkit.
Bring the leg of a boar

Good day, colleague! I hope you know that dogs belong to the vertebrates subtype... meaning their vertebral column starts with the head and ends with the tail. And here's the catch! One of my young collegues proved theoretically that the spine of the blind dogs - this is how you named this type of animals - starts from the tail, not from the head! Think of it, it totally turns upside down our assumptions pertaining to this area of knowledge. There are already some rather daring theories about human beings having around their sacrum a... well, this is a subject of many discussions. In short, we need the head of the dog, the blind dog, which through ignorance we considered to be its tail.
I'm up for it.
Bring the leg of a boar
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Bring the bloodsucker's jaw
What they are going to do with bloodsucker's jaw, I don't care. I care about how much they will give me for this rarity. Hand it in to Sakharov. Reward: 6000 RU and a science medkit.
Bring the bloodsucker's jaw

Oh, stalker, glad to see you! Listen... You already met bloodsuckers in your adventures, right? If not, then we want it to happen. Bring us the lower jaw of the representative of this species, with all his so to say tableware. Unfortunately, I can't disclose the details of the experiment, besides it will negatively impact the stability of your psyche. We'll be waiting.
I'm up for it.
Bring the bloodsucker's jaw
You did a great job! Allow me to present you with your reward.
Bring a boar's leg
Bring a boar's leg. Hand it in to Lukash. Reward: 1000 RU and a bottle of vodka.
Bring a boar's leg
We're planning a dinner party to celebrate Bob Marley's birthday. So why don't you get us some delicious ham? The more the better! Jah will never forget you!
I'm up for it.
Bring a boar's leg
Here's a fine young man! Excellent job, here's your money.
